title: UBAG Voice Relay Control Frame (protocol v2)
description: JSON payload of a type 0x02 control frame on the gateway/relay TCP link (see deploy/vps/browser/audio-relay.py). Frames are compact UTF-8 JSON (no insignificant whitespace). Key order is NOT significant: Go emits sorted keys, Python emits insertion order, and every consumer MUST parse by key. Unknown ops are logged and ignored by receivers, so they are intentionally outside this schema.

exp.description: Unix seconds; the relay refuses exp in the past or more than 300 s ahead.

token.description: hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, "voice-relay|<session_id>|<exp>")); when node_id and generation are present: hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, "voice-relay|<session_id>|<exp>|<node_id>|<generation>")) so the credential only verifies for that node and lease generation.

node_id.description: Optional (helper-hosted voice, P5.7): Helper Node the hello is bound to. Present together with generation or not at all (the relay answers bad_hello otherwise).

generation.description: Optional (helper-hosted voice, P5.7): lease generation the hello is bound to; the relay refuses a lower generation than the last accepted for the session.

oneOf.title: error (relay to gateway; the relay closes after a handshake error)
